settings.title: Settings

wechat.title: WeChat Connect
wechat.description: Connecting WeChat authorizes the connection only: nothing is processed and no reply is sent. Knowledge collection is optional and configured separately on each connection.
wechat.purposeHint: One purpose per connection: collect into a knowledge base, or run a published Agent. Saving a purpose activates it immediately; the configuration that is not in use is kept.
wechat.purposeBusy: A task is still active on this connection. Wait for it to finish, or stop the Agent task before changing the purpose.
wechat.agentHint: Send WeChat messages to a published Agent you can access. Each WeChat message runs the Agent and its reply is delivered back to WeChat; generated files can also be opened in the web conversation.
wechat.noAgents: No published Agents you can access are available.
wechat.agentVariablesHint: These values are used for every message sent to this Agent. Required variables without a default must be filled in.
wechat.agentInactive: No Agent configured. Messages are ignored.
wechat.agentStt: Speech recognition model (for WeChat voice messages)
wechat.agentInput: Inputs supported: text, images, files, voice and video, as permitted by the Agent and its team-authorized models. Unsupported content is rejected with an explicit reply.
wechat.agentStatusActive: Agent active. Recent messages are listed under Agent runs below.
wechat.agentReceiptsHint: One entry per WeChat message sent to the Agent. Delivery shows what happened to the reply in WeChat.
wechat.noAgentReceipts: No messages have been sent to an Agent from this account.
wechat.collectionReceiptsHint: Indexed means collection completed. A reply accepted by the WeChat API is not a guarantee that it appeared on your phone.
wechat.variableOptionInvalid: Choose one of the available options
wechat.bindingRule: Each WeChat identity has one connection. Each person authorizes their own connection; feature settings are configured separately.
wechat.failed: Unable to load or update WeChat connection settings. Please try again.
wechat.empty: No WeChat connections yet. Scan the authorization QR code to connect; a knowledge base is not required.
wechat.targetMissing: Target knowledge base no longer exists
wechat.connectionError: Connection needs attention. Authorize again with a new QR code; collection results remain available below.
wechat.disabled: Knowledge collection disabled. The connection remains connected.
wechat.noTargets: No writable active knowledge bases are available.
wechat.modelHint: Optional, team-authorized models. Images need vision; audio needs speech recognition unless WeChat provides a transcript. Video samples frames and transcribes its audio (maximum 30 minutes).
wechat.collectionInactive: Knowledge collection off. Received messages are ignored.
wechat.collectionHint: Optional. Enable collection to choose a knowledge base and recognition models. Already accepted submissions keep their original target and are checked again for permission.
wechat.qrLabel: Scan with WeChat to authorize the connection
wechat.bound: WeChat authorization completed. You can now send content to ClawBot.
wechat.disconnectHint: Stop receiving and processing submissions from this connection. Already collected documents remain in the knowledge base. Reconnecting requires WeChat authorization.
wechat.replyHint: Indexed means collection completed. A reply accepted by the WeChat API is not a guarantee that it appeared on your phone.

login.wait: Waiting for WeChat scan and approval…
login.expired: QR code expired. Close it and authorize again.
login.need_verifycode: Enter the verification code displayed in WeChat.
login.verify_code_blocked: Verification attempts exceeded. Close this QR code and start authorization again.
